summary: Mesoblast Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 24, 2026, announcing a webcast to discuss its full-year financial results and corporate update for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1, detailing the company's operational highlights and product pipeline. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is mentioned. This is a routine earnings-related disclosure by a foreign private issuer, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
